svg.title: Stack, scope and what production would need. Stack: React 19 and TypeScript built with Vite 7, react router 7, React Context state persisted to localStorage, hand written CSS on a token layer, vitest unit tests; product images are locally generated SVG garment illustrations with four views per colourway. Run: npm install, npm run dev, open localhost port 5173. Scope: mock catalogue with no backend, checkout is review and confirm with no payment, sign in is out of scope, size charts are plausible mock data and the engine has never been calibrated against real purchases or returns. Production would need real brand size charts, garment measurements, historical orders keyed to size, size specific return reason codes, post delivery fit feedback, and a powered A/B test.

section.h2: What it is, what it is not, what it would need.

div.div:
npm install
npm run dev
# localhost:5173

ul.li: Mock catalogue only, no live API, no backend
Checkout is review and confirm; no payment, no address
Sign in is visibly disabled, not dead
Size charts are plausible mock data, not real published charts
The engine is a heuristic, never calibrated on real purchases or returns
Guardrail metrics are named in the Fit Lab, not instrumented
